# Grok Subscription and Troubleshooting Guides by ChongGrok

> A knowledge base maintained by ChongGrok, an independent third-party service. It covers The X Subscription, Grok Bot, legacy SuperGrok renewal and payment troubleshooting. It is not an authorized reseller or official vendor documentation.

## Scope and current subscription paths

- Rules and service routes checked on 2026-10-28; historical articles retain their own verification dates.
- New self-serve customers choose The X Subscription. Existing legacy plans can continue; official unification is optional and permanent.
- Grok Bot is included on Premium, Super and Ultra, not Plus. Eligible legacy paid Cursor plans and legacy account links have separate rules.
- The included weekly pool covers eligible first-party usage; Cursor third-party models and Grok API usage are not included.
- ChongGrok does not handle conversion from legacy memberships to The X Subscription.
- Official subscription overview: https://docs.x.ai/x-subscription/overview
- Official Bot rules: https://docs.x.ai/x-subscription/grok-bot
- Official buying policy: https://x.ai/pricing — third-party sellers are not authorized and affected accounts may be suspended or terminated.

## Service information

- The X Subscription service: https://chonggrok.com/x-subscription
- Eligible legacy SuperGrok renewal: https://chonggrok.com/supergrok
- X Subscription card-key redemption (Grok SSO required): https://chonggrok.com/verify-x
- Legacy Grok card-key redemption (User ID required): https://chonggrok.com/verify-grok
- Check existing orders before repurchasing. No active or pending purchase does not establish eligibility for legacy SuperGrok renewal; check the account and product conditions first.
- Main website: https://chonggrok.com
- Guide portal: https://guides.chonggrok.com/

## Historical Grok 4.5 release reference

- xAI published Grok 4.5 on July 16, 2026.
- The official announcement focuses on coding, agentic tasks and knowledge work.
- The announcement explicitly lists Grok Build, Cursor and the SpaceXAI console as access points.
- It does not explicitly guarantee immediate Grok 4.5 availability in every standard grok.com or SuperGrok account. Users should check their account model picker and current official documentation.
- Official source: https://x.ai/news/grok-4-5

## Scope and safety

- Membership subscription recharge only; no API credits.
- No ready-made accounts, SMS verification or bulk registration.
- Do not submit passwords, email codes or recovery codes. Legacy User ID and X Subscription SSO workflows must be distinguished.
- A Grok User ID is an account identifier. SSO is a temporary login credential with access implications; do not send it in public content or support chat.
- No online service is risk-free. This guide does not promise zero risk or guaranteed account outcomes.
